entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: A blue-aligned human shard mage and javelin athlete from Meletis on Theros, who defied fate; a former planeswalker.

entities.name: Klothys
entities.description: Ancient goddess of destiny who returned from the Underworld to reweave and enforce fate.

entities.name: Calix
entities.description: Klothys's notable agent who sought to prevent Elspeth from leaving the Underworld.

entities.name: Fynn the Snakehunter
entities.description: Kannah leader troubled by visions.

entities.name: Kjell
entities.description: Kannah mystic who mentored Niko.

entities.name: Orhaft Stoneback
entities.description: Omenseeker Vedrune who explained that Niko was seen as a dark omen.

entities.name: Birgi
entities.description: God of boasting who goaded warriors into conflict at Jutmaw.

entities.name: Koma
entities.description: The Cosmos Serpent whose breach of Starnheim Niko helped drive back.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker who saved and was saved by Niko, and learned they were a Theran planeswalker.

entities.name: Tyvar
entities.description: Companion of Niko on Kaldheim and Duskmourn.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: Planeswalker who recruited the team to save Nashi.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: Companion on the Duskmourn rescue, accompanied by Kyodai.

entities.name: Zimone Wola
entities.description: Student of Strixhaven who joined the rescue; Niko accompanies her home.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: A nezumi on Duskmourn seeking his mother Tamiyo, rescued by the team.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: Nashi's mother, whose scroll echo is used by the cult.

entities.name: Aminatou
entities.description: Gave each rescuer a fateshifter.

entities.name: Winter
entities.description: A resident of Duskmourn's House who guides then betrays the group to the Cult.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: Demon of Duskmourn worshipped by a cult, who seeks to spread his influence beyond the House.

entities.name: Cult of Valgavoth
entities.description: Dangerous group dedicated to Valgavoth.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: A glowing dragon spirit representing the Wanderer's hopes and dreams.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: Ravnican detective whose magic opens an artificial Omenpath to Duskmourn.

entities.name: Fateshifter
entities.description: A crystallized measure of Aminatou's power over fate.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Niko's home plane.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: Plane of Niko's first planeswalk.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: A living haunted House plane.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: Realm of the Valkyries.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: Portals between realms and planes.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: Violent overlapping of realms on Kaldheim.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after which Niko lost their spark.

events.summary: Niko purposefully loses a contest, realizing they can take control of their fate.
events.quote: After purposefully losing a contest, they realized that they could take control of their fate.

events.summary: Klothys sends agents after defiers of fate; Niko's spark ignites in the confrontation and they leave Theros.
events.quote: but during this confrontation, Niko's spark ignited and they left the plane.

events.summary: Niko arrives on Kaldheim and is accepted by Fynn's Kannah band, mentored by Kjell.
events.quote: Niko was quickly accepted and mentored by Kjell , a Kannah mystic.

events.summary: Niko traps a Valkyrie to stop a death-heralding fight at Jutmaw.
events.quote: To prevent this, Niko successfully trapped one of them and sought help from the clan leaders.

events.summary: Niko warns the Valkyries and helps drive Koma back through the Omenpath.
events.quote: Niko took charge and helped them to drive Koma back through the Omenpath it had entered.

events.summary: Niko and Kaya save each other in Bretagard.
events.quote: There, Niko saved Kaya and was saved in turn by Kaya.

events.summary: Niko loses their spark and is trapped on Kaldheim after the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: only to be trapped there in its aftermath when they lost their spark .

events.summary: Aminatou gives each rescuer a fateshifter on Ravnica.
events.quote: the group was assisted by Aminatou , who gave each rescuer a fateshifter, a crystallized measure of her power over fate.

events.summary: The team rescues Nashi from wickerfolk.
events.quote: managed to rescue Nashi and defeat the wickerfolk by exploiting their fear of fire

events.summary: Winter betrays the group and the Cult of Valgavoth captures them.
events.quote: Niko, the Wanderer, and Nashi were captured after a betrayal by Winter, who sealed them in the room with the cultists.

events.summary: Valgavoth manifests and rewards Winter; the group escapes and Niko discharges their fateshifter.
events.quote: Niko was forced to discharge their fateshifter when a cultist stabbed them through the eye.

events.summary: Kaito opens an artificial Omenpath using Alquist Proft's magic for the group's escape.
events.quote: used Alquist Proft 's magic to open an artificial Omenpath from Ravnica to Duskmourn, which the group used to escape.
Niko accompanied Zimone to her home plane of Arcavios

relations.quote: Niko was quickly accepted and mentored by Kjell , a Kannah mystic.

relations.note: Niko was a target of her agents.

relations.quote: There, Niko saved Kaya and was saved in turn by Kaya.

relations.note: Betrayed the group; rewarded by Valgavoth.
relations.quote: Valgavoth manifested in the cultists' chamber to reward Winter for his betrayal
a dangerous group dedicated to the demon Valgavoth
They traveled around Kaldheim alongside Tyvar for some time to alleviate their boredom.
